page: Microsoft Azure NC36ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine from the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 Intel processor with 36 dedicated vCPUs and 132.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.67 GB of RAM per core. The instance is equipped with a single GPU and includes 1980 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, alongside support for Premium Storage.

This server configuration provides dedicated compute resources and high-speed local storage, making it suitable for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities. While benchmark data is not available for this specific instance type, the combination of dedicated Intel vCPUs, a hardware GPU accelerator, and fast NVMe SSD storage offers a balanced resource profile. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of bundled local NVMe storage and a dedicated GPU provides a consolidated platform for resource-intensive tasks without requiring external storage attachments.

The hardware profile of this instance is designed for workloads such as GPU-accelerated database operations, machine learning inference, data analysis, and rendering tasks. The 1980 GB local NVMe SSD provides the necessary read and write speeds for handling large datasets locally, while the 36 dedicated vCPUs support multi-threaded processing requirements.
